findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_templates, chat, audience_profile, optimize_email_for_prospect · Public sink: get_templates, analyze_platform, audience_profile, optimize_email_for_prospect · Destructive: execute_template, analyze_full_comms.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_templates, chat, audience_profile, optimize_email_for_prospect · Public sink: get_templates, analyze_platform, audience_profile, optimize_email_for_prospect · Destructive: execute_template, analyze_full_comms

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
